description: French glossary of the game's own text (docs/modding/translation-handbook.md). terms: English term of glossary_en.json -> the French form used in every file. keep_latin: unused for a Latin script. style: the rules of voice and form.

style.address: Harry and Cybil: vous in the cafe (first meeting), tu from the antique shop on. Harry and Lisa: tu from the start. Harry and Kaufmann: vous, both ways. Dahlia to everyone: tu, elevated and archaic (ne ... point is avoided, but inversion, 'nul', 'courroux', 'hâte-toi'); Harry to Dahlia: vous until the last scene, tu in the last scene. Dahlia and Kaufmann: tu, both ways. Lisa on the tape speaks to the doctor: vous. Alessa and Cheryl to a parent: maman, papa; Dahlia speaks of herself as maman.
style.gender: Participles and adjectives carry the speaker's gender (Lisa: assommée, inconsciente, descendue; Cybil: contente; Dahlia: saisie, imprudente, débarrassée). Where the speaker of a line is uncertain the wording is neutral (map6_s01 reunion, map4_s04 'Tu n'as rien, tant mieux.', the diary of map5_s02/map5_s03). The UFO ending addresses the aliens with vous.
style.quotes: « » with a space inside for the [ ] of the English; the dash is the character — (U+2014), which the English writes as '='.
style.punctuation: French spacing: a plain space before ? ! : ; (the game font has no narrow no-break space). build_lang.py keeps such a mark on the line of its word. Ellipsis is three dots as in the source.
style.item_in_sentence: an item name inside a sentence is lower case with its article outside the colour span: 'Il y a une <trousse de secours>. Prendre ?'; 'Prendre ?' is the same for every gender and number. Use message: '<Name> utilisé(e).' with the name as in the inventory and the participle agreeing. Received: 'J'ai trouvé un <reçu>.'
style.names_with_figures: Key of [Lion] -> Clé « Lion », Plate of [Cat] -> Plaque « Chat »: no article, so no du / de l' / de la variants.
style.floors: The source counts floors the American way and the in-game maps are labelled 1F, 2F, B2: descriptions say 'niveau 1', 'niveau 2', '2e sous-sol' rather than rez-de-chaussée / 1er étage.
style.units: Metric: 10 to 15 in. -> 25 à 40 cm, 3' -> 90 cm.

terms.God: Dieu (Il, Le, Sa with a capital)
terms.Handgun / Hunting rifle / Shotgun: Pistolet / Carabine de chasse / Fusil à pompe (balles de pistolet, balles de carabine, cartouches de fusil)
